requirements.text: * 5\+ years of experience in data science or growth analytics within an ads platform, marketplace, or high\-growth B2B environment.
* Proven track record of deploying machine learning models (propensity, LTV) that significantly moved business metrics.
* Strong SQL; proficient in Python or R.
* Experience thriving in ambiguous "0\-to\-1" environments, with a hands\-on approach to building data infrastructure and processes.
* Prior experience at a major scaled ads platform (e.g.edIn).
* A deep passion for artificial intelligence and proficiency in leveraging AI tools to accelerate modeling and insight generation.
